capabilities: move or copy files to target folders based on frontmatter properties or filenames
manage multiple ordered rules with exact or fuzzy matching and blocking values
monitor property or filename changes in real time, or trigger moves manually
batch-check and move all matching files via commands
archive entire folders and limit scanning to a chosen scope
extras: The marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to file notes into folders automatically based on metadata or names, so users must move files by hand.
summary: Rule-based automation that moves or copies notes to target folders when frontmatter properties or filenames match configured trigger values.
